_comment: AP3 Causal RAG reliability gates, numeric thresholds. Pre-registered 2026-10-29, before any real-model AP3 output exists (no smoke, fixture or replay output has been produced). Applies identically to both Causal RAG versions. Thresholds concern whether the agents work as specified; none uses investment performance, so no gate can select a version by its returns.

G3a_first_12_months.note: Confirms the locked limits (limits_v1.json) before the full replay; a limit change uses one of the three allowed limit versions and is recorded.

G4b_human_audit.sample: 40 Testing Agent outcomes, stratified by status and year, drawn with seed 20261027 before any label is read

checks: walk-forward with labels through t-2 only
G4c_calibration.gate: computations complete without look-ahead; values are reported, not used to choose a version

primary_version_rule: Recommended rule for the project lead's decision: the historical-documents version is primary if its corpus passes the corpus checks and the version passes G3a, G3b, G4a and G4b; otherwise the reduced-evidence version is primary if it passes them. Development performance of both versions is reported but is not a selection criterion. Protected-window results are never used.
